authorities.refusal: Reject an old monolith, missing destination, undeclared sibling, duplicate declaration or changed symbol, test, command or fixture inventory

authorities.grant: Independently compare the Assurance split inventory and preserved semantic controls
authorities.refusal: Reject changed identity binding, source materialisation, report bytes, bounds, privacy, selection or verdict semantics

resources.cleanup_failure: Return an infrastructure error without accepting the tree

success_semantics: Accepted means the declared Assurance split preserves declarations, tests, commands, fixtures, executable identity, source materialisation, bounds, privacy, selection and canonical report bytes
refusal_semantics: An old monolith, missing destination, undeclared sibling, changed inventory, duplicate implementation, wrapper or semantic regression returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release source is split directly; no old file, wrapper, alias, forwarding package or duplicate implementation is retained
falsifiers: A declaration, test target, command, fixture or package owner changes during the split
An old monolith remains or a declared destination file is missing
An undeclared sibling source or test file appears in a governed Assurance package
Executable identity, immutable source materialisation, process bounds or diagnostic privacy changes
Canonical report bytes, control selection, mutation identity, defect replay selection or CLI output changes
A wrapper, duplicate validator, alias or order dependency is introduced

production_controls.owner: source-policy Assurance split inventory and declaration fixtures
source-policy Assurance owner and call inventories
source-policy command, test and fixture inventory

assurance_controls.owner: independent Assurance split inventory and declaration comparison
runner identity, source, bound and diagnostic fault fixtures
canonical report, mutation, replay, rulepack, suppression and CLI fixtures

residual_limitations: This structural split does not establish new Assurance or Product behaviour
Native Windows execution and persistence remain separately governed
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change executable identity, source materialisation, report schema, report bytes, diagnostics, bounds, control selection or verdicts
Create an interface, wrapper, registry, option or duplicate implementation
Retain an old file, alias, forwarding package or compatibility path
Move or split Production code or another Assurance package
Change mutation definitions, defect replay commands, decision semantics, suppression policy, rulepack behaviour or CLI output
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the split inventory
